properties.fit_rationale: Switch Mobility is primarily in the automotive manufacturing industry with a focus on electric buses and light commercial vehicles, which involves significant metal fabrication and precision engineering in the manufacturing process. The company has manufacturing operations in India with a sizable workforce of 501-1,000 employees, indicating strong procurement potential. Their operation in India and product type closely align with Atharva Metals & Engineering's ICP, with clear needs for metal components and manufacturing services. Sub-scores: Industry fit 33, Geographic fit 20, Company size 18, Need signals 22, totaling 93.
properties.name: Switch Mobility

message.content: Hi Tilak, I noticed Switch Mobility’s focus on electric buses and light commercial vehicles involves complex sheet metal components that require consistent precision and quality. At Atharva Metals & Engineering, we specialize in high-volume sheet metal stamping with presses ranging from 80T to 500T, supporting OEMs in automotive sectors right here in India. Would you be open to a brief call to discuss how we might support your manufacturing needs?
